title: Treating cystitis in women
what: Cystitis is inflammation of the bladder, most often caused by germs. It is usually treated with a short course of medicine.
why: For burning and pain when you pee, frequent urges to pee, and pain low in the belly.
duration: the visit takes 15 to 30 minutes; a urine test usually takes 1 to 3 days, a urine culture 3 to 7 days
tell_doctor: How long it has bothered you and how often it happened before
If you have a fever or lower back pain

prepare.title: Urine test
prepare.text: Usually you need morning urine in a sterile container, after washing.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not start antibiotics on your own before the test, if you can wait for the visit.

prepare.title: Drinks
prepare.text: Drink plain water as you usually do.

bring: A urine container, if you were asked to bring one
Past test results, if cystitis keeps coming back
steps: The doctor asks about your symptoms
You are sent for a urine test
Sometimes you are examined or an ultrasound is ordered
Treatment is prescribed, and the doctor explains how to take it
If cystitis is frequent, more tests are ordered
feel: You usually feel better after 1 to 3 days of treatment
after: Finish the whole course, even if you feel better
Do not hold it in when you need to pee
If cystitis comes back, see the doctor again
red_flags: A fever over 38°C and lower back pain
No improvement after 2 to 3 days of treatment
Symptoms of cystitis during pregnancy: see a doctor the same day

faq.q: Can a heating pad cure cystitis?
faq.a: Warmth can sometimes ease the pain, but it does not get rid of the germs. The doctor prescribes treatment.

faq.q: Why does cystitis keep coming back?
faq.a: There are many reasons. If it comes back often, the doctor will order tests and suggest ways to prevent it.

reminders.text: Cystitis visit tomorrow. If you need a urine test, collect your first morning urine in a sterile container.
